Ginkgo biloba
Possibly effective for cognitive 
function, dementia, general-
ized anxiety disorder, and 
schizophrenia, premenstrual 
syndrome, peripheral vascular 
disease, vertigo, glaucoma, 
and diabetic retinopathy.
80-240 mg standardized  
extract and 3-6 mg of a  
40 mg/mL liquid extract 
in 2-3 divided doses per 
day has been used. 30-40 
mg in a tea bag has also 
been used.
Generally considered safe except 
in high-risk patients. Ginkgo 
can reduce blood pressure, de-
crease blood sugar, and cause 
mild gastrointestinal discomfort 
in some. Some reports of  
dizziness and sedation
